fusions.name: Snap Shot
fusions.desc: Fires a crack of arcana up to 8 tiles that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.3 times at full range.

fusions.name: Report of Power
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to load, then fires a round of condensed arcana that deals 40 damage. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Rifled Channel
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to cast. For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Chambered Rounds
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a round loads on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all fire at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per round (204% at full). Unfed, a round fades every 6 seconds.
